Create wireframes and the user flow

## Goal

Plan every MVP screen before writing the code. Low fidelity is fine.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `/wireframes` has a wireframe for every MVP screen, named by screen (for example, `home.png`).
- [ ] A user-flow diagram shows which screens are tabs, what is pushed, and which routes are dynamic.
- [ ] `/wireframes/README.md` lists the files and the tool used.
- [ ] The wireframes match the screens in the Software Development Plan.
- [ ] The wireframes are merged into `develop` through a reviewed pull request.

## Where to look

Canvas: [Team] Software Development Plan & Wireframes, and KICKOFF! Project Planning and Team Collaboration, section 2.
